labels.shortDescription: Loyalty transaction: amounts do not add up
labels.value: Fuel amount plus other amount must equal the total amount.

labels.shortDescription: Loyalty transaction: fuel amount and liters inconsistent
labels.value: Fuel amount and liters must either both be zero or both be greater than zero.

labels.shortDescription: Loyalty transaction: purchase date in the future
labels.value: The purchase date must not be in the future.

labels.shortDescription: Loyalty transaction: settings missing or invalid
labels.value: Loyalty settings (Loyalty_Settings__mdt.Default) are missing or invalid. No points were awarded.

labels.shortDescription: Loyalty transaction: ledger entry could not be saved
labels.value: Points could not be recorded, the purchase was not saved: {0}
The member is blocked or cancelled and cannot earn points.
The account is not a registered loyalty member.
Member, purchase date, total amount, fuel amount, other amount and liters are required.
Amounts and liters must not be negative and the total amount must be greater than zero.

labels.shortDescription: Loyalty transaction: processed purchase is locked
labels.value: A processed purchase cannot be changed. Use a correction entry instead.
